mapper.select: select dev_hash, band, country from user_devices where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into user_devices (user_id, dev_hash, agent, band, country) values (cast(#{uid} as uuid), #{h}, #{agent}, #{band}, #{country}) on conflict (user_id, dev_hash) do update set agent = excluded.agent, band = excluded.band, country = case when excluded.country = '' then user_devices.country else excluded.country end, last_at = now()
mapper.delete: delete from user_devices where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and dev_hash not in (select dev_hash from user_devices where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) order by last_at desc limit 20)
mapper.select: select email from users where id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
select name from tenants where id = #{tid}

select dev_hash, agent, band, country, to_char(first_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') first_at, to_char(last_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') last_at from user_devices where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) order by last_at desc limit 20
